annotations.title: My open privacy deadlines (Fristen meiner Firma)

description: Lists the open data protection deadlines of the organisation connected to this frag.hugo account: data breaches with their 72-hour reporting deadline (Art. 33 GDPR), data subject requests with their one-month deadline (Art. 12(3) GDPR, incl. extensions) and records of processing or processor agreements waiting for review by the data protection officer. Returns type, deadline, status and an app link per entry — no descriptions, names or contact details. Requires a connected frag.hugo account. Not for deadlines of laws in general (use get_compliance_deadlines).

art.description: Which deadlines: data breaches (72 h), data subject requests (one month), entries awaiting DPO review, or all

sprache.description: Output language. Default: German if the input is German, otherwise English.

name: my_privacy_deadlines

datenpannen.description: null = not requested or no permission
